exercises.name: Body Waves
exercises.cue: Gentle bend; keep both heels flat.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.cue: Make small arm circles with steady feet.

exercises.name: Overhead Arm Raises
exercises.cue: Raise and lower your arms without rising onto your toes.

exercises.name: Arm Swings
exercises.cue: Swing arms gently; keep feet still.

exercises.name: Trunk Twists
exercises.cue: Turn the upper body gently without pivoting your feet.

exercises.name: Seated Marches
exercises.cue: Sit upright and lift one knee at a time.

exercises.name: Modified Windmills
exercises.cue: Reach only towards the opposite thigh; do not bend deeply.

exercises.name: Chair Sit to Stand
exercises.cue: Stand and sit slowly using a sturdy chair.

exercises.name: Body Taps
exercises.cue: Tap your shoulders, arms and thighs gently.
